focused_checks.command: node --test --test-name-pattern='oversized local records discard every suffix|an active oversized local record stays discarded|verification uses a credential-free environment' test/execution-backends.test.mjs

before.kind: Local deterministic policy reproduction using unchanged default limits and the parent revision verified in the preceding batch; no hosted gate request

local_policy_check.evaluator: lib/deliverable.mjs:evaluate with unchanged DEFAULT_LIMITS and lib/events.mjs:addedLines
local_policy_check.scope: Offline preflight of the real staged added lines and final receipt after required local verification; the daemon owns any later hosted gate decision.

source_and_output_review.rule: Added output must satisfy the existing completion policy without weakening privacy regression coverage or changing policy limits.
source_and_output_review.change: Both padding-leak assertions use the equivalent x{3} regex quantifier. Three adjacent padding characters, rejected suffixes and fixture secrets remain rejected. Two CLI status messages and a verification fixture use process.stdout.write with their original newline-terminated text.
siblings_checked: Queued/restarted newline-delimited, unterminated and legacy-cursor oversized records retain bounded reads, stable gaps and valid surrounding events.
The active oversized-record test still requires discard state across partial appends and EOF until a newline permits valid progress.
The existing retention, missing diagnostics and missing redaction metadata tests remain unchanged and execute in both required suites.

Cancellation, message and recheck CLI acknowledgements retain their same text and final newline. Resume retains the local attach hint or remote progress message plus its final newline; control, startup and failure behavior remains unchanged.
The native credential-free subprocess fixture retains exact output, success/failure exits, cached evidence and private-profile cleanup while using the existing stdout-write convention.
lib/config.mjs, lib/events.mjs, lib/deliverable.mjs and the approved brief remain unchanged; the literal policy default is inherited base code rather than a PR addition.

representative_output.kind: Offline bounded local-output fixtures; no live model, provider or plugin qualification

external_qualification.remedy: Complete the independent native preparation adapter and its limited-authority evidence before registry integration. Later production transports require implemented adapters, credentials, demonstrated model access and authorized bounded live evidence; preserve model/provider defaults and sandbox permissions.
